quotes.text: It uses the common convetion of "C: " for data the Client sends, and "S: " for received data from the Server. Other parts do not have prefixes.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical EWS logger introduced C: for client payloads and S: for server payloads. Current shared send_request logs operation ID/name and response status, while request and response bodies are logged only when THUNDERBIRD_LOG_NETWORK_PAYLOADS is present. The gate checks presence, not a particular value, and current payload conversion uses from_utf8_lossy. Preserve those distinctions when extending this shared request logger. Historical MOZ_LOG_FILE and release compile-level caveats are commit-reported and were not verified as current behavior. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep protocol log correlation and payload output distinct
